movementPerRail._rule: THE DISPATCH'S GATE, answered as the two classes the upsert's own guard creates -- because only one of them can move a value. UPSERT_CELLS_BATCH_SQL refuses exactly one incoming state (unaccounted) over a stored non-unaccounted cell; value and absent-verified are both APPLIED.

class1_nodesTheBindResolves.whatItCanMove: a rail whose merged row is null emits absent-verified, which WOULD overwrite a stored value. This is the only class in which a value can be lost.
class1_nodesTheBindResolves.storedStateBesideIt: P-310's ledger census 2026-09-17 (p310-factory-census.mjs): yearBuilt 233,250 value / 49,320 absent; livingAreaSqft 233,277 / 49,293; exemptionCodes 0 / 95,384 (plus 187,186 unaccounted). So 24 of the 44 cannot move anything -- the rail holds no value to overwrite.
class1_nodesTheBindResolves.bound: <= 20 field instances of 2,922,576 value cells (0.0007%), of which the store's own composition predicts ~16-17 (82.5% of yearBuilt cells are values).
class1_nodesTheBindResolves.whyNotZero: for those 30 parcels the pair's account is silent on a field the address-matched account carries, and the pair wins. The absence that results is asserted against the account the county itself publishes as this parcel's; the stored value came from a different account.
class1_nodesTheBindResolves.theAlternativeNotTaken: refusing the pair where the address path disagrees makes the movement EXACTLY zero (the rails emit unaccounted, which the guard refuses) and is affordable: residue 350 -> 398, still inside P-310's 433. Not taken because it lets a 0.019% heuristic veto the identifier the county publishes (A-215 ruling 7 / P-310 option b), and because it FREEZES the 48 on values the pair contradicts instead of correcting them. If the planner prefers the letter of the zero rule, the variant is one predicate in loadWilliamsonWcadCrosswalk and costs 48 of the 433.

class2_nodesWithNoEntry.canItMoveAValue: NO, by the guard's own code: an incoming unaccounted over a stored non-unaccounted cell is a no-op. This is a property of UPSERT_CELLS_BATCH_SQL, not a measurement -- which is why these 350 are counted separately (railsUncleared) and never added into class 1's number.
class2_nodesWithNoEntry.whyCountedAtAll: so a reader can see how much the residue's rails COULD have carried, without conflating it with the class that can actually overwrite.

movementPerRail.otherRails: zero, and by construction rather than by luck: for every rail, the merged row carries everything the node's own R row carries AND everything the pair's account carries (mergeWilliamsonPairRow is add-only), so the only cells a bound parcel's run can flip are those where BOTH rows are silent and a THIRD row (the address path's, on a divergent account) spoke.
movementPerRail.theLedgerLegWasNotReRead: this seat holds no FACTORY_DATABASE_URL / FACTORY_DATABASE_URL_RO (parcel_record_cell does not exist in CORTEX_DATABASE_URL's store -- scripts/p335-store-probe.mjs). So 'is the stored cell a value?' is answered from P-310's 2026-09-17 census, not from a fresh read, and the integration seat should RE-TAKE it before any apply. This is a bound and a bound is re-measured at the moment it matters.

residueAnswerConfirmed.guardReadFromCode: UPSERT_CELLS_BATCH_SQL (src/jobs/parcel-record-fill.mjs) sets cell_state = CASE WHEN EXCLUDED.cell_state->>'kind' = 'unaccounted' AND parcel_record_cell.cell_state->>'kind' <> 'unaccounted' THEN parcel_record_cell.cell_state ELSE EXCLUDED.cell_state END -- only unaccounted is refused.
residueAnswerConfirmed.answer: YES: a crosswalk VALUE replaces a stored join-miss absent-verified cell, and that is the intended repair, not a violation of the guard (the guard stops DOWNGRADES, it does not freeze a wrong claim). P-310's stored absences (25,743 per money rail, 26,043 per situs-city rail, 95,384 on exemptionCodes) are exactly the cells the pair's values repair: the field the cell calls verified-absent is present on the county's own roll for the parcel's published account.
residueAnswerConfirmed.whatCannotBeCleared: the 350 nodes neither the pair nor the situs path reaches emit unaccounted, which the guard REFUSES over their stored absences -- those cells keep their old claim and are counted, never silently left as truth. Clearing them needs an operator-sanctioned one-off sweep (a reviewed statement over the join-miss-basis cells of the unbound residue, population counted first), which this lane does not write and does not run.
residueAnswerConfirmed.noSecondUpsertPath: none invented; the dispatch's constraint is honoured by counting and naming instead.

p351AnswerConfirmed.short: YES, and it is the same pair from the same side: NODE (R account) -> published pair -> NUMERIC account -> byPropId lookup.
p351AnswerConfirmed.counts: 48491's declared vintage is 2026 (cad-export); cad_property at 48491/tax_year 2026 is 319,480 rows, ALL numeric, while the served node population is 282,569, ALL R-prefixed. byPropId therefore has no R key at all and buildConformantTier1Payload's recordRetirement arm (apn != null && cadPropConsulted && byPropId.get(apn) == null) fires for every one of them.
p351AnswerConfirmed.direction: the pair must be applied BEFORE the byPropId lookup (apn -> account -> byPropId.get(account)); looking up the R key directly is what misses today, and the reverse direction asks the roll to name a key it does not carry.
p351AnswerConfirmed.whatThisLaneDidNotDo: no edit to legacy-design-tools (out of this lane's repo); P-351's lane decides where the bake reads the pair from -- the same two staged extracts (tx_wcad_owner, tx_wcad_ag_valuation) the factory writer now reads.
